property_summary: After a call to newGrantProposal, proposalCount increments by exactly 1 in the reference contract, while the mutant increments it by 2, so the contract's proposalCount will be strictly greater in the mutant for the same number of calls.
After a successful call to newGrantProposal, the proposal type stored for the new proposal in mapPID_type must be 'GRANT'; the mutant stores an empty string instead, breaking this invariant.

After any number of calls to newGrantProposal, the reference contract's proposalCount always equals the number of successful calls, while the buggy contract's proposalCount stays at 0, causing it to differ.

After any call to newGrantProposal, the increment of proposalCount equals the number of new grant proposals initiated; the buggy version increments proposalCount by 2 per call, violating this one-to-one correspondence.
The VADER address returned from the DAO contract must equal the _vader argument supplied to init.
